name: eq-hihat
description: Crisp tick with air, low clutter gone, never harsh. High low-cut is the defining move.
notes: Precondition: Hihat track selected in Cubase, insert 0 loaded per opencode/reference/eq-hihat.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
Air shelf (~0.6); low-cut frequency manually by resolved title.
Dry by design: no send.set calls; study stays upfront.
